description: REMix-NZ energy system optimisation dataset: five scenarios for electricity, heat and transport decarbonisation, 2020 to 2050, published by Canessa, Rafaella, packages REMix model inputs, build scripts and results for five New Zealand decarbonisation scenarios. Coverage: New Zealand across 11 regional nodes, with seven model years from 2020 to 2050 and 8,760 hourly periods per model year. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Scenario outputs are optimization results, not forecasts or observations. Execution requires REMix, Python and GAMS with Gurobi or CPLEX. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: data-remix-eur-european-energy-system-data is another REMix input collection for a different region, not coverage of the New Zealand study.
